question_text: Outline two reasons an iterative traversal may be preferable to recursion for counting qualifying records in a long linked list.
adaptation_rationale: Original application rewritten to be self-contained; assessed reasoning retained within cited 2027 scope.
solution: Recursive calls retain a frame for each active call.; A very long list can therefore consume large stack space or hit a recursion limit.; Each recursive call adds call/return overhead.; A simple loop with a counter can perform this traversal without that extra overhead.
